mentions.name: Live Kaiwa
mentions.description: Real-time Japanese conversation support tool that transcribes Japanese speech live and provides English translations, summary bullets, and suggested responses during ongoing conversations. Browser microphone audio streams via WebRTC to a server running Kotoba Whisper with multi-pass transcription (a quick first pass followed by higher-accuracy re-transcription that replaces earlier text), and each transcript batch is sent to an LLM whose output is streamed back to the UI live. Session data stays entirely in the browser with nothing stored server-side.
mentions.problem: Fast speech, local dialect, and references to people and events from decades ago made neighborhood meetings in rural Japan nearly impossible to follow, despite day-to-day Japanese being fine.
mentions.audience: The author, for following local neighborhood meetings in rural Japan
